name: ALEPH: A Detector for Electron-Positron Annihilations at LEP

summary.plain: The ALEPH collaboration's own full technical description of the finished detector.
summary.technical: Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 294 (1990) 121-178 (report CERN-EP-90-25); the standard ALEPH detector-paper reference, describing the vertex detector, inner tracking chamber, time projection chamber, calorimeters, magnet and muon system as installed at LEP start-up.
